title: How Billie started on heroin and her pill drawer
summary: A man from Dallas introduced her to a hypodermic; he describes her nightly routine.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Billie Holiday as the musicians knew her

blocks.x: So now, when Billie started, I say don't do it baby. I say you don't know what you're letting yourself in for, you know.
Oh, here we go into this thing. A white boy from Dallas called Speck, he was freckled face. He had slipped up to her dressing room and made himself acquainted while

I was at work, you know. Across the street. And introduced her to a hyperdermic, showing how many CC's and everything and her being adventursome, she went for it. And every night that he came by, he was giving it to her free until finally she had to have it, then he was coming back and getting the money.

You know, saying I haven't got anything, Lady. Nope so and so has, how much does it cost, so and so. She'd give him the money and he come on back. But he'd take what he wanted first, you know. So one night when we had an electrical storm and she had fixed before she went to bed. And she would be wringing wet with perspiration. I couldn't stand to get close to her because there -- it would be uncomfortable for her, you know, this body heat.

So I started sleeping on the couch, but I didn't know that this is what was happening. All of a sudden in a clap of thunder and a streak of lightning and brought her up out of this sleep and she landed on her feet in the middle of bed and grabbed her stomach and ran to the bathroom.

She came back in, all nice and quiet and poured her a big slug of scotch, a tumbler of ale behind it. Went to the dresser drawer and she had a ten pound candy box of assorted pills, and she would just reach in there, she didn't pick out a certain one. Just some pills, tossed them up in the air and throw them down her mouth and chased it with ale. And then she might sit down and smoke a joint before she go back to bed.
So at that time, I could go to the lingerie drawer, I could get as high as two-three thousand dollars in her dresser drawer if I wanted it. But I had my own money, I didn't need hers you know.
